text: Yes, the 2022 loss was corroborated by the independent reference. The JRC 2020 dataset confirmed that 100% of the event area was mapped as forest in 2020, meeting the 50% threshold required by the corroboration rule. Additionally, the loss was observed in a later year (2022) within the Hansen GFC series, and the event area (0.6 ha) exceeded the minimum size (0.5 ha). The MGAP forest map further validated the area as native forest, with no planted forest present.
